RELIANCE.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
RELIANCE.about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.
RELIANCE.keyPoints: Reliance Industries Limited holds key business stakes, including 66.43% in Jio Platforms (RJIL). Additionally, it maintains an 83.56% ownership each in Reliance Retail Ventures and Reliance Consumer Products, alongside a 59.59% holding in JioStar.

HDFCBANK.name: HDFC Bank Ltd
HDFCBANK.about: India's largest private sector bank by assets; banking and financial services company headquartered in Mumbai.
HDFCBANK.keyPoints: One of India's 3 systemically important banks with ~15% share of banking-sector advances and ~37% of private-bank advances (FY24).

INFY.name: Infosys Ltd
INFY.about: Infosys provides consulting, technology, outsourcing and next-generation digital services; India's 2nd largest IT services company behind TCS.
INFY.keyPoints: Digital Services: offerings in customer experience, AI-based analytics and big data, digital products and IoT, legacy modernisation, cloud migration and cyber-security.

BHARTIARTL.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
BHARTIARTL.about: One of the world's leading telecom providers with presence in 18 countries across India, Sri Lanka and 14 countries in Africa.
BHARTIARTL.keyPoints: Segments: Mobile, Broadband, DTH and Bank. Operations in India, Africa, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka.

LT.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd
LT.about: Multinational conglomerate primarily engaged in EPC solutions across Infrastructure, Hydrocarbon, Power, Process Industries and Defence, plus IT and Financial Services, in India and overseas.
LT.keyPoints: Infrastructure Projects were 47% of revenue in FY26 (51% in FY25): buildings & factories, transportation, heavy civil, power T&D, renewables, water, minerals & metals.

TITAN.name: Titan Company Ltd
TITAN.about: Lifestyle company with leadership in Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear; founded in 1984 as a JV between the Tata Group and TIDCO.
TITAN.keyPoints: As of FY26 the Tata Group held 25% (21% via Tata Sons) and TIDCO held 28%.

SUNPHARMA.name: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd
SUNPHARMA.about: Manufactures, develops and markets branded and generic formulations and APIs, with manufacturing facilities across the world.
SUNPHARMA.keyPoints: Generics, branded generics, specialty pharmaceuticals, advanced technology-based products, antiretrovirals, APIs and intermediates, in multiple dosage forms.

MARUTI.name: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd
MARUTI.about: Market leader in Indian passenger vehicles; a subsidiary of Suzuki Motor Corporation (Japan) since 2002 and SMC's largest subsidiary by production and sales.
MARUTI.keyPoints: Segment-wise domestic sales 9M FY26: Compact 41.6%, Utility vehicles 37.7%, Vans 7.3%, Mini 5.3%, LCV 2%, OEM sales 6%.

BAJFINANCE.name: Bajaj Finance Ltd
BAJFINANCE.about: Lending business with a diversified portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers in urban and rural India; also accepts public and corporate deposits.
BAJFINANCE.keyPoints: India's largest private-sector NBFC; loans, fixed deposits, payments, insurance and mutual funds via app, web and branch network.

ETERNAL.name: Eternal Ltd
ETERNAL.about: Eternal (previously Zomato), incorporated 2010, is a leading online food-service platform: food delivery, dining-out, loyalty programs and more.
ETERNAL.keyPoints: Four principal businesses (Q2 FY27): Zomato (food delivery), Blinkit (quick commerce), Hyperpure (B2B supplies), District (going-out).

TRENT.name: Trent Ltd
TRENT.about: Retailer of apparel, footwear, accessories, toys, games, food, grocery and non-food products through multiple retail formats (Westside, Zudio, Star).
TRENT.keyPoints: Part of the Tata Group (~37% group shareholding: 32.5% Tata Sons, 4.3% Tata Investment Corporation).

DIXON.name: Dixon Technologies (India) Ltd
DIXON.about: Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) company (est. 1993): consumer electronics, lighting, home appliances, CCTV and mobile phones; also reverse logistics.
DIXON.keyPoints: Mobile & EMS was 90% of FY26 revenue (85% in FY25): feature phones, smartphones, IT hardware, telecom, hearables & wearables; key client Samsung. Consumer Electronics & Appliances 6% (9%).

POLYCAB.name: Polycab India Ltd
POLYCAB.about: India's leading manufacturer of cables and wires and allied products; also consumer electricals (fans, switches, switchgear, LED lighting, solar inverters).
POLYCAB.keyPoints: Wires & Cables were 87% of FY26 revenue (84% in FY25); 9,650+ SKUs and a 30-31% share of the organised domestic market.

CGPOWER.name: CG Power & Industrial Solutions Ltd
CGPOWER.about: End-to-end solutions for utilities, industries and consumers for efficient electrical energy, in two segments: Power Systems and Industrial Systems.
CGPOWER.keyPoints: Promoted by Tube Investments of India, part of the Murugappa Group (agriculture, engineering, financial services and more).

DEEPAKNTR.name: Deepak Nitrite Ltd
DEEPAKNTR.about: Incorporated in 1970; manufactures Basic Intermediates, Fine & Speciality Chemicals, Performance Products and Phenolics.
DEEPAKNTR.keyPoints: 36+ products and 56+ applications in 2 segments; Phenolics were 68% of FY26 revenue (70% in FY25): cumene, phenol, acetone, IPA, AMS for laminates, auto, construction and pharma.

KAYNES.name: Kaynes Technology India Ltd
KAYNES.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is an end-to-end, IoT-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company: conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing and life-cycle support for automotive, industrial, aerospace & defence, space, nuclear, medical, railways and IoT customers.
KAYNES.keyPoints: End-to-end IoT-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing services (IEMS); has also ventured into smart metering, advanced semiconductor packaging (OSAT) and high-density interconnect PCBs.

NAVINFLUOR.name: Navin Fluorine International Ltd
NAVINFLUOR.about: Produces refrigeration gases, inorganic fluorides and specialty organofluorines, and offers contract research and manufacturing services (CRAMS); 50+ fluorinated compounds.
NAVINFLUOR.keyPoints: Part of the Padmanabh Mafatlal group; in fluorochemicals since 1967; one of India's largest specialty fluorochemical companies and a pioneer in refrigerant gases. 60+ fluorinated compounds serving agrochemicals, pharma, aluminium smelting, refrigeration and more.

CREDITACC.name: CreditAccess Grameen Ltd
CREDITACC.about: Non-deposit-taking NBFC-MFI registered with the RBI, lending to women organised as Joint Liability Groups, and distributing other financial products through the same channel.
CREDITACC.keyPoints: Microfinance lender to low-income households, primarily women, in rural and semi-urban India; ~6.9% share of the overall microfinance industry.

PERSISTENT.name: Persistent Systems Ltd
PERSISTENT.about: Software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernise their businesses, with its own software and frameworks; partners include Salesforce and AWS.
PERSISTENT.keyPoints: Global digital services provider focused on AI-led, platform-driven digital engineering and enterprise modernisation: product engineering, data & AI, cloud modernisation, CX transformation, intelligent automation and analytics.
